subject: Re: NovaHealth - Order Form change: throughput increase + SOW clarifications
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Order Form changes + SOW clarification

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week. We ran a short internal forecast and would like to request a change order to the current order form (Deal NH-2027-0419):

- Increase committed throughput by 30% (starting 2027-04-01)
- Adjust pricing cadence for months 6-12 (propose 3% discount on committed tokens vs current list)
- Clarify Statement of Work Exhibit B — specifically the acceptance criteria for the integration window and rollback triggers.

We're on a tight timeline and need an execution path so procurement can approve by 3/22. Can your team send a draft change order and highlight any legal/ops blockers we should expect?

Attachments: none yet.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovaHealth
procurement@novahealth.com
[phone redacted]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form changes + SOW clarification

Emily — appreciate the quick turnaround on the ask. I've drafted a concise change order and a redline for Exhibit B that addresses: throughput increase, a month 6-12 temporary price band, and tightened acceptance language for the integration window.

High level notes / potential blockers:
- Throughput increase: our Dedicated capacity team needs a 2-week provisioning lead time; target start 2027-04-15 to be safe. We flagged this in section 2.a of the draft.
- Pricing: the 3% discount is doable but requires a minimum 12-month commit on the incremental band (we proposed that in the fee schedule).
- SOW acceptance: added clearer rollback triggers (latency > 250ms p50 sustained for 30m or error rate > 2% for 15m). Ops will need to confirm monitoring hooks.

Attached: NH_changeorder_draft_v1.docx, SOW-exhibitB_v3-redline.pdf (redlines inline).

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal review for commercial redlines (Karthik) — can you check the fee language and the commit terms?
2) Ops/Implementation confirm provisioning window and acceptance metrics (Laura/Connor).
3) I will incorporate final edits and send for procurement signature via DocuSign.

Emily — can you confirm whether NovaHealth needs an interim credit or launch waiver for the first 30 days of the increased throughput? That will affect billing proration.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: NH_changeorder_draft_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
[Attachment: SOW-exhibitB_v3-redline.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form changes + SOW clarification — legal redline review

Rachel — reviewed the draft change order and Exhibit B redline. Summary of legal comments:

- Fee band / discount: change "minimum 12-month commit" to "minimum 12-month commitment on incremental throughput, subject to early termination fee equal to 20% of remaining committed value" — we need language to avoid churn risk. Added suggested clause in section 4.2.
- Acceptance metrics: the rollback triggers are fine, but we should add an operational notice period (48 hours) before an automated rollback is actioned to allow remediation.
- Provisioning lead time: include a sentence that Redwood is not liable for missed SLAs for the first 7 days post-provisioning due to warm-up activities (ops dependency).
- Liability / indemnity: changed narrow language to reference the master MSA indemnity sections rather than inventing new carve-outs in the change order.

I attached a short PDF with tracked suggestions (SOW-exhibitB_v3-redline.pdf). If you want, I can produce a clean change order for signature once we lock the pricing line and the provisioning date.

Karthik Iyer
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form changes + SOW clarification — implementation notes

Team — ops notes against the redline: 

- Provisioning window: we can meet an 04/15 start if NovaHealth confirms final capacity figures by 03/20 EOD. We will schedule a 3-day maintenance window for warm-up and a 24-hour observability verification period after cutover.
- Monitoring hooks: require a small agent (1 container) installed in NovaHealth test cluster to surface p50/p95 and error rates; added to Exhibit B as "Observability Integration, Section 1.3".
- Rollback process: agree with Karthik on 48-hour notice, but operations will require the ability to initiate immediate rollback if safety thresholds are crossed and remediation fails within 60 minutes. Added escalation path and on-call roster to the SOW redline.

Connor — I'll need the runbook stub and a list of the on-call names to append. Emily — please confirm the test cluster access and timing.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Implementation Services, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: implementation_runbook_stub.txt (text/plain)]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form changes + SOW clarification — final change order for signature

Emily — thanks for the quick confirm on capacity numbers earlier today. Per our internal reviews we've incorporated:

- Finalized effective start date: 2027-04-15 (provisioning lead time accounted)
- Pricing: incremental band discount confirmed at 3% with a 12-month minimum commitment and early termination fee (see section 4.2)
- SOW Exhibit B: updated acceptance criteria, observability integration clause, 48-hour notice before auto-rollback with emergency immediate rollback escalation language, and implementation runbook stub attached.

Attached is the clean change order and the final Exhibit B PDF. Please review and sign via DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCDE-12345-NH

If procurement needs an interim billing credit during launch week, we can offer a one-time 10% credit on incremental consumption (requires procurement confirmation in DocuSign comments).

Next steps:
1) Emily to approve and sign the change order in DocuSign (target 3/22)
2) Laura / Connor to schedule provisioning calendar (target kickoff call 03/29)
3) Karthik to close out the redline and confirm no further legal open items.

Thanks everyone — looping back once signed.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NH_changeorder_FINAL.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
